user_saw: While Gateway diagnostics were open, operators could see CPU spikes and delayed chat responses, especially with a large retained task history.
summary: The fix moved status database reads to the SQLite worker, summarized task metadata without restoring the full registry, and shared the read across overlapping requests.
reasoning: The August read-only status change already loaded the complete task snapshot synchronously, including delivery state and integrity checks. The activity-graphs commit exposed that cost by adding a full Gateway status RPC every five seconds on the Connection page, and I verified that the RPC called the existing status summary. The companion diagnostics fix replaced that poll with system.info, while this fix addressed the cost of the backend status path itself.
